title: The sealed variants get domains of their own, written by an independent agent
request: The owner: do the rest of the plan non-stop; the survey of phase 9 found the sealed variants drawn from the same four skins as practice, and LRN-008 found column names memorised across skins.
spec: PHASE9_LEARNING_LOOP_PLAN.md 31.3: three sets near 5:3:2, the sealed one generated independently; Part I: an independent agent that never read the rules or the lessons writes the sealed variants.
plan: Read how a skin is defined
Brief an independent writer with the generator's interface only
Check its names against the practice skins
Wire the skins into sealed variants only

decisions.why: practice and check variants and their stored baselines stay exactly as they were; the sealed set was never read, so changing it now spends nothing
independence: it saw neither the rules, the lessons nor the existing skins, only the fields' roles

decisions.decision: Clashing names sent back to the same writer
decisions.why: two names matched practice names; fixing them myself would have broken the independence
the lesson screen then refuses any lesson naming a sealed column

change: dclab_core/variants.py (SEALED_SKINS, SEALED_SKINS_SHA256, the sealed pick, the knob, family_names; dclab-core 0.140.0); tests/test_sealed_skins.py; the plan's status.

findings.defect: The writer's first draft reused two practice names
findings.scenario: Checking the eight skins against the practice skins' names.
findings.cause: The writer did not see the practice skins (by design), and two common names (a sales channel, an account number) matched.
findings.fix: The writer replaced them, given the list of names to avoid.

measurements.name: practice and check variants against the previous generator
measurements.gate: every table and key identical, byte for byte

outcome: Sealed variants now test DCLab on domains whose names it never practised on, while practice and check are unchanged.
lessons: An exam drawn from the practice generator tests memory of names as much as skill: change the surface, keep the trap.
risks: The generator's structure (the same columns' roles and signal) is shared by every partition; an independent structure is a later step.
